compiled_state.title: [dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets]: ticket list-epics tab detection -> existing tickets treated as missing
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** aa2d12c5a8

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh uses \`ticket list-epics --has-tag=<alias>\` and detects an existing ticket by the presence of a tab character in the output (tab-separated epic line). Running the script twice should skip ticket creation on the second run.

#### Actual Behavior

The original implementation used \`ticket exists <alias>\` which always exits 1 for text aliases (only accepts UUID-format IDs). This caused all three calibration tracking tickets to be re-created on every run, producing duplicates and breaking the idempotency guarantee.

Test suite caught this via test_no_op_when_all_exist and test_uses_list_epics_for_idempotency in tests/scripts/test-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh — both tests ran RED until the implementation was fixed to use ticket list-epics with tab detection.

comments.body: Fixed: bootstrap script now uses ticket list-epics with tab detection for idempotency (commit aa2d12c5a8). 8/8 bootstrap tests pass.
comments.author: Test
